code_identity_contract.submission_value: EXPECTED_COMMIT is the full 40-character candidate SHA supplied to qsub
code_identity_contract.required_equality: EXPECTED_COMMIT == clean worktree HEAD == manifest identities.code.commit

time_and_tie_contract.time_source: injected nondecreasing integer monotonic nanoseconds with time.monotonic_ns as the production default
time_and_tie_contract.grace_start: the first observation satisfying both distinct eligible and fresh thresholds
time_and_tie_contract.grace_end: the first observation at or after start plus the frozen grace period while both thresholds still hold
time_and_tie_contract.quorum_loss: an observed loss before freeze cancels grace and recovery starts a new full grace interval
time_and_tie_contract.equal_time_total_order: phase transitions are evaluated by ascending fragment index and claims use cyclic distance from the round-robin cursor then fragment index

selection_stability.freeze_point: the grace-ending observation or the threshold observation when grace is zero
selection_stability.frozen_fields: authority content identity version ordered proposal content identities and exact CandidateWeight tuple
selection_stability.late_arrival_rule: proposals observed after freeze are ignored until the active lease is resolved and new authority is installed
selection_stability.directory_order_rule: candidate normalization and proposal policy ordering make input permutation irrelevant
selection_stability.duplicate_rule: identical duplicate proposal identities are one observation and different proposals from one learner contribute at most one

fairness.scheduler: deterministic cyclic round robin over frozen fragments
fairness.observation_point: each successful claim_next return while no earlier lease remains active
fairness.starvation_window: a fragment continuously frozen from an observation through service must be claimed within at most F successful claims
fairness.adversary: fragment zero is released and immediately rearmed between claims while all other fragments stay frozen
fairness.assertion: maximum continuously-ready service window is at most F for every initial cursor

restart_and_boundedness.authority: current immutable FragmentGlobalState plus exactly M per-learner ConsumptionFrontier entries
restart_and_boundedness.restart: constructing a new machine from authority conservatively restarts an unfinished grace and never scans proposal history
restart_and_boundedness.poll_cost: exactly M times F fixed-slot reads per complete poll independent of unrelated filesystem objects
restart_and_boundedness.resident_state: constant counters plus one authority phase and at most one frozen selection of at most M proposals per fragment and one global active lease
restart_and_boundedness.consumption_component: advanced fixed frontiers reject repeated current-slot proposals; atomic frontier publication remains S1-11

formal_assertions.cross_node: writer and syncer execute on distinct PBS hosts and communicate application state only through shared POSIX files
formal_assertions.profile_a: all four fragments freeze exactly eight distinct fresh learners with zero grace and claim in order 0 1 2 3
formal_assertions.once_only: after frontier installation every repeated Profile A poll has zero frozen and selected proposals
formal_assertions.grace: the fifth learner observed before freeze is included and the sixth published after freeze does not change selection or weights
formal_assertions.gpu: both roles report zero GPU memory before and after their workload
formal_assertions.stderr: all packaged and scheduler stderr files are empty

formal_package: S1-00 builder finalizer and validator with clean code config source skill scheduler role path and checksum identities plus fail-if-exists root
failure_ladder: preserve the first formal L2 package and reproduce both roles on one compute node with the same candidate and profile before any resubmission
